answers.answer: No, keep the three‑day schedule. Rest days are essential to allow recovery after a missed week and to avoid over‑reaching. Stick to Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday and adjust volume as your body feels.

new.analysis: The athlete missed the entire last week, so the priority is to re‑establish a routine without increasing load too fast. Three easy runs—one interval and two continuous—mirror the week‑36‑38 pattern while keeping total mileage near 9 km. No hard or quality session is needed this week; recovery and confidence are the goals. I watch rest‑day soreness, heart‑rate drift on the intervals, pace on the continuous run, and overall weekly mileage to ensure it stays in the 7–9 km range. The athlete asked whether to run every day; the answer keeps the three‑day schedule for safety and recovery.
